d: Which animal has the most powerful bite? The animal kingdom teems with biting techniques, each one finely adapted and deadly efficient. An animal's bite can provide vital clues to what it eats, how it kills and how much force is in its jaws. Herpetologist and host of Nat Geo’s Dangerous Encounters, Brady Barr, measured the current bite force world record for bone-crushing capacity - a crocodile in South Africa. But Barr thinks he may have found a more powerful set of jaws, those of a wild Nile crocodile in Tanzania. Now, Barr's mission is to capture and beat the previous world record. With…
